steps.caption: Sit together
steps.voice: Hi, friends. I'm your music teacher. Let's get ready to play together.
steps.parentCue: Sit side by side, so you both see the screen

steps.caption: Phone flat
steps.voice: Lay the phone flat on the table, like a little piano.
steps.parentCue: Or stand it up sideways in a stand, so it cannot slide

steps.caption: Sound on
steps.voice: Grown-up, turn the sound up and switch off silent mode.
steps.parentCue: Turn the phone sideways for a bigger piano

steps.caption: You play
steps.voice: You are the piano player today.

steps.caption: Grown-up helps
steps.voice: Grown-up, you are the helper. Point, cheer, and guide a finger when needed.
steps.parentCue: You never need to play perfectly

steps.caption: White and black keys
steps.voice: Here are the piano keys. Long white keys, and little black keys.

steps.caption: Two black keys
steps.voice: Find two black keys, side by side.

steps.caption: This is C
steps.voice: Just to the left of them lives C, our home key.
steps.parentCue: The same key is middle C on a real piano

steps.caption: One finger
steps.voice: Hold up your pointer finger. That's your tapping finger.
steps.parentCue: On a tablet, small hands can rest a curved hand on the keys

steps.caption: Gentle taps
steps.voice: Tap gently, like touching a bubble. Then lift your finger up.
steps.parentCue: One tap at a time. Resting a palm on the glass presses keys

steps.caption: Listen: C
steps.voice: Listen. This is how C sounds.

steps.caption: The glowing key
steps.voice: When a key glows, that's the key to tap.

steps.caption: Falling blocks
steps.voice: Blocks fall down to the keys. When a block lands, tap.
steps.parentCue: Coral blocks are your child's notes, blue ones play by themselves

steps.caption: Finger numbers
steps.voice: The numbers are finger names. Your thumb is number one.
steps.parentCue: 1 is the thumb, 5 is the little finger, as on a real piano

steps.caption: One to five
steps.voice: Wiggle each one with me. One, two, three, four, five.
steps.parentCue: Touch each finger as you count

steps.caption: Watch
steps.voice: When you see the eye, it's watch time. Hands in your lap.

steps.caption: Watch
steps.voice: Watch the key light up. Here I go.

steps.caption: Your turn
steps.voice: When you see the hand, it's your turn. I wait for your tap.

steps.caption: Together
steps.voice: When you see two friends, we play together, at the same time.

steps.caption: Bear low, bird high
steps.voice: Keys on the left sound low, like a big bear.
steps.parentCue: Keys on the right sound high, like a little bird

steps.caption: Bear! Tap down low
steps.voice: Tap any key on the bear's side, on the left.
steps.parentCue: Any key on the left counts

steps.caption: Bird! Tap up high
steps.voice: Now the little bird. Tap any key on the right.
steps.parentCue: Any key on the right counts

steps.caption: Tap the beat
steps.voice: When the circle grows, tap any key. Tap, tap, tap.
steps.parentCue: Any key is fine on the beat

steps.caption: Pause or stop
steps.voice: Grown-up, pause at the top any time. Close stops the class.
steps.parentCue: We save your place, so you can come back later

steps.caption: Stars
steps.voice: At the end of each class, you get stars for playing together.

steps.caption: Mistakes are fine
steps.voice: Tap a different key, and it just makes its sound. Then try the glowing one.
steps.parentCue: There is never a fail sound. Cheer for trying

steps.caption: Your first note
steps.voice: Now your very first note. Find C, our home key.

steps.caption: Your turn!
steps.voice: Your turn. One gentle tap on C.
steps.parentCue: Point to C if your child needs help

steps.caption: You did it!
steps.voice: You did it! You played your very first note.

steps.caption: Ready to play
steps.voice: That's how Little Duet works. Now let's play a song together.
steps.parentCue: Pick a song from Home to start your first class
